sentences.text: 信贷紧缩通常是信贷可得性的下降，且与官方利率上升无关。
sentences.evidence: A credit crunch generally involves a reduction in the availability of credit independent of a rise in official interest rates.

sentences.text: 信贷紧缩常伴随放贷者与投资者“逃向优质资产”，往往以中小企业受损为代价。
sentences.evidence: Many times, a credit crunch is accompanied by a flight to quality by lenders and investors, as they seek less risky investments, often at the expense of small to medium-sized enterprises.

sentences.text: 其常见起因是一段持续的草率、不当放贷，在贷款变坏时给放贷机构和债权投资者造成损失。
sentences.evidence: A credit crunch is often caused by a sustained period of careless and inappropriate lending which results in losses for lending institutions and investors in debt when the loans turn sour
